messages:
sam-support: FYI escalated from enterprise customer (ACME) — their Redwood Console analytics dashboard on iPhone shows legend labels swapped relative to line colors, tooltips report wrong values, and some metrics for the last hour show as "---" (missing). They also hit a 500 from /v1/metrics/timeseries?range=1h during troubleshooting. Ticket #4521. Screenshot: https://acme.screens/abc123

alice-support: ack — assigning to eng. tagging @ben-eng and @eva-mobile to triage. Any quick repro steps or console errors we can pass to the customer? :eyes:

ben-eng: I can take it. Can you paste the curl that hit the 500 and the browser console logs from the session? Also what iOS & Safari versions?

sam-support: iOS 15.6 / Mobile Safari. curl (from their dev):

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics/timeseries?metric=latency&p95=true&range=1h"
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"internal error","code":500}
```

Browser console (from their remote session):
```
analytics.js:1 Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'map' of undefined
at renderLegend (analytics.js:120)
at renderChart (analytics.js:90)
```

ben-eng: repro steps I used on staging: open Console -> Analytics -> select API Latency -> time range 1h -> toggle compact mode. When viewport width < 420px the legend order flips and labels get swapped with colors. The TypeError comes from a small race where series metadata arrives after the UI layout pass. Also backend 500 correlates with a memcache miss path in metrics ingestion; stack: 

```
ERROR metrics-service: panic: nil pointer deref
goroutine 1023 [running]:
main.(*TimeseriesHandler).ServeHTTP(0xc000...)

```

eva-mobile: seeing the same on iOS Safari and WKWebView. The CSS change in the recent analytics-ui PR set `.legend { flex-direction: row-reverse; }` for small widths which reorders visual elements; combined with the racey render we get label-color mismatch. Mobile tooltip positioning also broken because we changed `transform` origin.

ben-eng: root causes: 1) UI: the compact-mode CSS change + async series metadata leads to label<->color binding mismatch; 2) Backend: a memcache edge case caused a nil deref leading to 500 on some queries. I'll push small fixes: revert the row-reverse change and add defensive guards so legend render waits for series metadata; add memcache nil-check.

carol-product: recommended path: quick rollback of analytics-ui commit a1b2c3 to stop user-facing regressions, then merge a safer patch that keeps compact styling but avoids row-reverse. Also flag for postmortem on metrics ingestion lag (possible Redis eviction pattern). Can we do a canary rollout to Dedicated customers first?

deploy-bot: starting deploy: patch/analytics-legend-fix -> staging (build 2026.03.17.12).

ben-eng: deployed to staging. Validation steps for QA: 1) open dashboard on iPhone emulator (iOS 15); 2) toggle compact mode; 3) select 1h range; 4) confirm legend order matches series colors and tooltips show correct values; 5) run the curl above and ensure 200.

sam-support: did a remote session with ACME — after staging patch they reported legend correct and tooltips fixed, and the API 500 no longer reproducible. Customer asked for ETA to prod.

ben-eng: scheduling prod rollout to start in 30m with canary 10% then 100% pending no errors. Will monitor metrics-service logs and error-rate dashboard.

carol-product: thanks everyone. Please attach the session transcript and screenshots to ticket #4521 and mark escalation resolved after prod stable. :white_check_mark:

sam-support: confirmed with customer that this fixed their mobile layout and missing metrics. Closing escalation. :tada:
